Description: Establish robust ingestion, validation, and cleaning pipelines for telco customer records.
Given raw telco customer records in CSV format, when ingested via pandas pipeline, then all records are parsed and schema is validated.
Given blank whitespace entries in TotalCharges, when cleaned via numeric coercion, then missing values are converted to 0.0 without pipeline failure.
Given customer tenure, contract type, and payment method attributes, when scoring rules are applied, then an index score (0-100) is assigned.
Design and deploy multi-metric Streamlit analytics dashboard for executive decision making.
Given filtered customer subsets, when dashboard renders, then Total Customers, Churn Rate %, Total MRR, and At-Risk MRR display instantly.
Given interactive filters, when user selects Contract or Internet Service, then grouped bar charts update dynamically.
Given filtered views, when stakeholder expands the data drawer, then corresponding customer records are viewable in tabular format.
Create workflow triggers and intervention playbooks for customer success teams.
Given customers flagged with RiskScore > 70, when batch pipeline runs, then accounts are tagged as High Risk for priority handling.
Given Month-to-Month customers with >12 month tenure, when flagged for churn risk, then an automated annual discount offer is generated.
Perform data audit, prompt engineering documentation, and repository finalization.
Given all GenAI prompts used across BA/DA/PM tracks, when compiled into prompt_library_used.md, then prompt efficiency audit is fully documented.
Given all artifacts across 4 project directories, when README is structured, then architecture diagrams, KPI metrics, and run instructions are showcased.
